grid.$comment: A grid of equals that finds its own column count: `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, min-width), 1fr))`. The whole responsive behaviour hangs on ONE length — how narrow a card may get — and the browser derives every breakpoint from it, so there is none to write. The inner `min(100%, …)` is the overflow guard: on a viewport narrower than the minimum itself, the track yields to the container instead of forcing a horizontal scroll.
grid.$comment-min-width: The narrowest a column may be before the grid drops a column. 16rem is 256px at the default root size — a card that still fits a heading, two lines and a control. In rem for the container's reason: larger type asks for wider cards, and gets them without a second declaration. Per-instance needs are the same token scoped on the element — the token IS the input.

min-width.$description: Minimum width of a cell before the grid wraps.

grid.$comment-gap: One step of the spacing scale between cards, both axes — the stack's base step, because a grid row and a stacked block are the same distance apart in one composition.
